## Description {#details}

<p>This analysis provides information for a loop nest.</p>


<p>The analysis runs on demand and can be initiated via AM.getResult&lt;LoopNestAnalysis&gt;.</p>


<p>Definition at line 202 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/loopnestanalysis-h">LoopNestAnalysis.h</a>.</p>
